items.question: What is included in a Manicure & Pedicure?
items.answer: A manicure and pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak includes nail trimming, shaping, cuticle care and moisturising, starting with a consultation and nail assessment. Nail colour or gel is optional, depending on the service you choose. Both together cost IDR 238.000 per person, or IDR 99.000 for a manicure and IDR 139.000 for a pedicure.

items.question: What is the difference between a manicure and a pedicure?
items.answer: A manicure focuses on the hands and fingernails, while a pedicure treats the feet, toenails and areas such as the heels and cuticles. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, a manicure costs IDR 99.000 and a pedicure IDR 139.000 per person, or IDR 238.000 for both, at our spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: How often should I have a Manicure & Pedicure?
items.answer: Many guests book a manicure and pedicure every two to three weeks, although the ideal schedule depends on nail growth and personal preference. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, both together cost IDR 238.000 per person, and gel nails, at IDR 219.000 for hands or feet, give a longer-lasting finish.

items.question: Can I choose gel nails instead of regular polish?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, gel nail application is available as a separate treatment for guests who prefer a longer-lasting finish. Gel costs IDR 219.000 per person for hands or feet, or IDR 438.000 for both, while regular nail colour is IDR 69.000 for hands or feet.

items.question: Can I book Manicure & Pedicure at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon therapists provide manicure and pedicure as professional home service throughout Seminyak and nearby areas, bringing all required equipment. In the Seminyak area, home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist to the treatment price: IDR 99.000 for a manicure, IDR 139.000 for a pedicure or IDR 238.000 for both, per person. Book on WhatsApp.

items.question: How much does a manicure and pedicure cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A manicure and pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 238.000 per person, or IDR 99.000 for a manicure and IDR 139.000 for a pedicure. Nail colour is from IDR 69.000 and gel from IDR 219.000. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Packages from IDR 299.000 per person add a cream bath, massage or facial.

items.question: How long does a manicure and pedicure take?
items.answer: A manicure or a pedicure at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes about 30 minutes, and both together about an hour. A manicure is IDR 99.000, a pedicure IDR 139.000 and both IDR 238.000 per person.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your manicure and pedicure on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
